rubric: The browser died before the scenario ran.

criteria.cause: the target, the dev server, the browser or a tool failed; the scenario was never really tried

reading.why: The browser process was killed before the first step and the second row was never tried: a tool failed and the scenario was never really tried.

ruledOut.question: cause
ruledOut.label: product_bug
ruledOut.why: A tool failed before the scenario was tried. It is not: the app does not do what the scenario asks.

ruledOut.question: cause
ruledOut.label: test_bug
ruledOut.why: A tool failed before the scenario was tried. It is not: the scenario or the way it was driven is wrong; the app behaves as intended.
